title: Deep Learning-Assisted Fingerprint-Inspired Flexible Pressure Sensor for Tension Monitoring in Carbon Fiber Production.
summary: CNN takes normal/abnormal tension signals from a pressure-sensor system; 498 original samples split stratified 8:1:1, with SMOTE applied only to training set; 96% test accuracy. This validates a lab/production-monitoring classifier, not broad industrial performance. Published in Advanced Science.
